title: Scientific reasoning
learning_outcomes: Explain hypotheses in the context of scientific reasoning.
Compare and distinguish controls and confounding in the context of scientific reasoning.
Apply causal inference in the context of scientific reasoning.
Evaluate and justify decisions about replication in the context of scientific reasoning.

lessons.title: Hypotheses
lessons.outcome: Explain hypotheses in the context of scientific reasoning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving hypotheses; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to experiment protocol.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain hypotheses from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of hypotheses; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Controls and confounding
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish controls and confounding in the context of scientific reasoning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving controls and confounding; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to experiment protocol.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain controls and confounding from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of controls and confounding; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Causal inference
lessons.outcome: Apply causal inference in the context of scientific reasoning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving causal inference; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to experiment protocol.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain causal inference from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of causal inference; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Replication
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about replication in the context of scientific reasoning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving replication; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to experiment protocol.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain replication from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of replication; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of hypotheses; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of controls and confounding; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of causal inference; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of replication; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
